properties.notes: A range of garages and small-scale buildings are currently in situ but the land offers potential for redevelopment in what is predominantly a residential area. A scheme was consented for 5 detached dwellings but this permission lapsed without being implemented (10/S/00036/VARYCO). This permission extended the time limit of original application (03/D/0614, CM/200610322). The yield reflects adjacent residential development.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
